title: Pack manifest
description: The pack.yaml file at the root of a content pack. engine/assets/src/pack_manifest.cpp applies the same rules.

layer.description: The content layer, from the bottom up: base (1), remaster (2), mods (3), user (4). A higher layer overrides the assets of the lower ones.

priority.description: Orders the packs of one layer: the higher one wins. Packs with the same layer and priority are ordered by their dependencies, then by id.

description.description: What the pack changes or adds.

dependencies.description: Packs that must be mounted too, at least at the given version, in the same layer or a lower one.

packId.description: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

version.description: A semantic version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, without pre-release or build suffixes.
